description: HazeWatch turns NASA MODIS and VIIRS fire detections into one burning-activity calendar for the Indonesian provinces whose smoke reaches Singapore. The sensors disagree on confidence, revisit time and coverage, so the multi-year record fire managers need does not exist as a comparable series. HazeWatch harmonises both into one calendar, flags the provinces and wind windows that precede haze episodes, and gives a shared evidence base for early warning. Solo entrant, Singapore.
